nice!!! now, so when adding a pivot or joint, we need to give it a name. like front left or front right. that way we can just assign them later by saying something like a binding of tires.offroad_left.pivot to trucks.tundra.joint.back_left
the thing is that, a wheel has one correct outward face, so we have to save a wheel for example as both views, unless we want to script it, but that doesnt always work for everythingk, just for tires it does
resolution: Naming pivots + joints for bindings (req_1052). Established the binding addressing scheme: <library>.<model>.pivot (the part's single pivot) and <library>.<model>.joint.<name> (named sockets, many per part) — e.g. tires.offroad_left.pivot bound to trucks.tundra.joint.back_left. A joint's NAME is its binding key (must be unique; added renameMount to editMesh which auto-suffixes a clash, loud not silent), while TYPE stays the compatibility class (axle/shoulder, mountsCompatible) so a truck's four axle joints share a type but differ by name. Joints are now editable (name/type/axis/limit) in the column-3 metadata panel (see req_1053). The left/right mirror problem (a wheel has one correct outward face) is resolved as a workflow decision: save both views as separate models (general), script-mirror as a tires-only shortcut; a + mirror duplicate helper is noted as a follow-up. editMesh 41/41 (+renameMount test), bundles clean, hot-reload, uncommitted. Spec in PLAYBOOK Part 6.1a/6.1b.
